mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rk_email_code (email, code, expire_at, used) VALUES (#{email}, #{code}, #{expireAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, code, expire_at, used, created_at FROM rk_email_code WHERE email = #{email} AND used = 0 AND expire_at > NOW() ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE rk_email_code SET used = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rk_email_code WHERE email = #{email} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND)
